title: Strategy Inc August 10, 2026 Form 8-K treasury update
excerpt: As of August 9, Strategy reported 840,447 bitcoin, a USD 4.65 billion reserve, 6,585,682 MSTR shares sold and 1,152,020 STRC shares repurchased during the week.
summary: The filing updates Strategy's treasury and financing state through August 9, including common issuance, a 1,690-bitcoin sale, STRC repurchases and reserve growth.
